prompt.text: Use your spawn_subagent tool exactly once, subagent_type general-purpose, run_in_background false, and wait for its result. Give the subagent these instructions verbatim: "Run these shell commands with run_terminal_command, one call each, in this order. The first three in the foreground: `echo sub-fg-1`, `echo sub-fg-2`, `echo sub-fg-3`. Then run `sleep 20; echo sub-bg-done` with block_until_ms set to 0 so it runs in the background. Do not wait for it or poll it. Then reply with the word done." Do not run any shell command yourself. When the subagent returns, end your turn with the single word: finished.
